context: Evaluates whether the candidate correctly uses the normalizeProduct and normalizeCart utility functions from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce. Tests knowledge of the normalization layer that converts Kibo-specific GraphQL response shapes to the standard @vercel/commerce data model, including field mappings for id, name, slug, price, and images.

checklist.name: Uses normalizeProduct
checklist.description: The solution imports and calls normalizeProduct from the package rather than manually mapping fields from the Kibo API response.

checklist.name: Uses normalizeCart
checklist.description: The solution imports and calls normalizeCart from the package for converting raw Kibo cart data.

checklist.name: Correct import paths
checklist.description: Functions are imported from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce (e.g., from the package's lib/normalize or main export), not reimplemented or imported from @vercel/commerce.

checklist.name: id from productCode
checklist.description: The normalized product's id field corresponds to the Kibo productCode field (demonstrating knowledge of the field mapping).

checklist.name: Both functions exported
checklist.description: Both the normalizeProduct wrapper and the normalizeCart wrapper are exported from the module.
